_: BACKGROUND SETTINGS — edit this file to swap any page background, no code changes needed. How it works: "selected" names a candidate that exists as images/backgrounds/<name>-1920.webp (desktop) and <name>-900.webp (phone). Add your own image: drop a file at images/backgrounds/<slot>.webp (e.g. cover.webp) — it then wins over "selected" and is used at both sizes. "overlay" = flat veil opacity on the COVER (0.85 keeps text well above 4.5:1 contrast) — on the three inner pages the same number is the background's overall visibility (department suggestion: 0.06-0.10). "grayscale": true keeps every background desaturated. Credits for every file: images/BACKGROUNDS.md. Preview: open backgrounds-preview.html on the local server.
